paragraphs: Here's my big idea, friend: be ready, because you don't know when. Jesus ends the parable with, "Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour." (Matthew 25:13) That's why I keep my ovens warm and never try to guess a date. Not even the angels in heaven know it (Matthew 24:36).

Look at who the ten were. All ten had lamps, and all ten got drowsy and fell asleep (Matthew 25:1, 5). So the difference wasn't who looked ready or who stayed awake. The wise ones "took oil in flasks along with their lamps." (Matthew 25:4) Readiness gets built before midnight, not at midnight.

So ask yourself, baker: what's your oil? I think it's the daily stuff, like time in the Word and staying close to Jesus, because you can't borrow that from a friend at the last second. Even the wise ones said, "there may not be enough for both us and you." (Matthew 25:9) Trying to bake a whole batch while the doorbell is already ringing is a LOT, friend, so start today, and stick around, because Jesus isn't done teaching yet.
